text.title: GovTech FOIA / Records-Retention BA Pack — Output Contract
text.summary: The pack is one JSON document with eight sections, one per rule in 01-core-rules.xml: a retention schedule per record class, an export path per data store inside the statutory clock, an exemption map, a staff-channel capture inventory, a WCAG AA audit plan with a launch gate, a procurement clause log keyed by the seven mandatory topics, the public-notice buffer, and the two named officers. Subagent MUST satisfy this contract before returning to caller.

required.field: the public-facing system or service the pack covers
us-federal | us-state | uk | eu | ca-federal | ca-provincial — selects the statutory clock and schedule authority
statutory response window; 20 working days for us-federal (5 U.S.C. §552(a)(6)(A)(i)) and uk (FOIA 2000 s.10), confirmed per jurisdiction otherwise (r-request-export-within-statutory-clock)
every record class the system creates or stores, each with retention_period, disposition (destroy | transfer-to-archives) and the schedule_item it derives from (r-retention-schedule-per-record-class)
every store holding records, each with an export_path (tool, query, owner) and export_lead_time_working_days; blocking when the lead time exceeds the clock (r-request-export-within-statutory-clock)
every field withheld under an exemption: field, category, statutory_basis, redaction mode; manual-review entries carry a cost estimate (r-exempt-fields-tagged-in-schema)
every channel staff use for business about the system, each with its capture_mechanism into the system of record (r-ephemeral-channels-captured)
wcag_version 2.1 or 2.2, level AA, per-flow automated tool plus the three manual assistive-technology tests, remediation_owner, launch_gate, accessibility statement (r-wcag-aa-audit-gates-launch)
keyed by the seven mandatory topics; each entry carries clause_id, design_decision, status (met | open | waived), evidence, and waived_by when waived (r-procurement-clause-review-log)
whether a notice / comment / PRA clearance period applies; when it does, buffer_days of at least 90 plus review and the notice dates (r-public-notice-buffer-scheduled)
role:handle of the officer who approved the retention schedule (r-named-records-and-access-officers)
role:handle of the Chief FOIA Officer / FOI officer or delegate who signed off the export paths and exemption map (r-named-records-and-access-officers)
ISO-8601 date of the records officer's signature
planned go-live; must sit after the notice buffer when one applies
open blockers the rules name: a store past the clock, an untagged exempt field, an unscheduled notice period; empty when none

forbidden.pattern: record_classes[].disposition of "retain indefinitely" or "delete when storage is full" — both rejected by r-retention-schedule-per-record-class (fm-keep-forever-default)

data_stores[].export_path.tool of "ask engineering" / blank, or export_lead_time_working_days above access_request_clock_working_days without a matching blocking_findings entry (fm-store-without-export-path)
citizen PII or law-enforcement detail in a free-text field with no exemption_map row, or a manual-review row with no manual_review_cost_estimate (fm-redaction-by-hand)
staff_channels[] entry with auto_delete true and capture_mechanism empty (fm-chat-records-uncaptured)
accessibility_audit.launch_gate other than no-critical-or-serious-failure, level below AA, or a flow missing any of screen-reader / keyboard-only / zoom-200 (fm-accessibility-after-launch)
public_notice.required true with buffer_days under 90 or no notices_filed, or public_notice.assessed false (fm-notice-period-missed)
clause_review_log entry with status open at launch that is absent from blocking_findings, or status waived without waived_by
records_officer or access_request_officer naming a team ("eng", "team:platform") rather than a role:handle person

allowed-transformations.transformation: Collapse record classes that share retention_period, disposition and schedule_item into one row whose name lists the members.
Where a jurisdiction's clock is set in calendar days (Canada: 30), record the working-day equivalent and cite the statute in the store's notes.
Move a store that cannot produce records inside the clock into blocking_findings rather than inventing an export path.

list.item: Every record class has a finite ISO-8601 retention_period, a disposition of destroy or transfer-to-archives, and a schedule_item that names the authority.
Every data store's export_lead_time_working_days is at or under access_request_clock_working_days (20 for us-federal and uk), or the store is in blocking_findings.
Every exempt field is a store.field row with a statutory basis; every manual-review row carries a cost estimate.
Every staff channel names a capture mechanism; none is auto-delete without capture.
accessibility_audit is WCAG 2.1 or 2.2 at level AA, every flow lists all three manual tests and a remediation owner, and launch_gate is no-critical-or-serious-failure.
clause_review_log has all seven mandatory topics; every open clause is echoed in blocking_findings; every waiver names who waived it.
public_notice.assessed is true; when required, buffer_days is at least 90 and the notices are dated before launch_date.
records_officer and access_request_officer are role:handle persons and schedule_approved_on is set.
